content: s3d v0.2.1 GitHub release (checked via api.github.com 2026-10-21) ships 5 native binaries: s3d_windows_amd64.zip (~7.0MB), linux_amd64/arm64, darwin_amd64/arm64. Windows dev install needs no Go toolchain, no Docker. v0.2.1 (2026-10-05) is the latest release; CHANGELOG 0.2.1 headline: 'Report live transfer stats' (the TransferStats/ActiveUpload additions).
